categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Touches functional test framework polling intervals in test/functional/test_framework/test_framework.py and test/functional/test_framework/test_node.py.
categories.rationale: Reduces test suite idle time across CI and local runs by shortening polling sleep intervals during node synchronization and RPC readiness checks. The author demonstrates a 13% reduction in local wall time and 9% to 15% reductions across various CI environments.
